content.thinking:
I see the bug in my generator: the coefficient vector is scaled by K=8 (since weights sum to 8), so `v = Σ coef*q = K*value`, and I compared `lo = fv` (unscaled) — wait no, in the *generator* I compute M values as Fractions of the true metric (unscaled) and set lo/hi from those. That's correct.

Looking at the output: coef (0,...,8,...) with val 6814 means v = Σ coef*q = 8*... hmm, val printed is Fraction(v,K) = 6814 = the true demand. And range = 6816. So the observation says demand = 6816 but truth is 6814. That's a "violation" of 2 — meaning my generator's `off=0` case produced lo=fv-w, hi=cv+w with w... hmm, fv=6814, cv=6814, so lo=6814-w, hi=6814+w. Range [6816,6816] means off was applied (viol case): lo = cv + off = 6814+2 = 6816. So this observation was intended to be violating → but it's assigned domain null (trusted)! Because in the generator, `dom = rnd.choice(doms) if rnd.random() < 0.8 else None` is chosen independently of whether the observation is violating. So ~20% of violating observations become trusted → contradictions → infeasible.

Fix: if the observation is violating (off ≠ 0), always assign a domain (never null). Let me fix that.

Also: coefficient all-zero with val 0 and range [1,1] — that's an ingress/egress observation on a node with no commodities → always violated → must be domain-assigned.

Let me fix the generator: when violating, pick a domain (if domains exist), else make it non-violating.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='biggen.py'
s=open(p).read()
old = """            if rnd.random() < viol:
                off = rnd.choice([1, 2, 10, 100, 1000, 5000])
                lo = cv + off
                hi = lo + w
            else:
                lo = fv - w
                hi = cv + w"""
new = """            bad = rnd.random() < viol and doms
            if bad:
                off = rnd.choice([1, 2, 10, 100, 1000, 5000])
                lo = cv + off
                hi = lo + w
            else:
                lo = fv - w
                hi = cv + w"""
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
old2 = """            dom = rnd.choice(doms) if rnd.random() < 0.8 else None"""
new2 = """            dom = rnd.choice(doms) if (bad or rnd.random() < 0.8) else None"""
assert old2 in s
s = s.replace(old2, new2)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 biggen.py 0 > big0.jsonl 2>/dev/null; time (/workspace/submission/run.sh < big0.jsonl > big0.out); python3 -c "
